· Collaborate daily with production and management on Continuous Improvement projects
· Identify and resolve issues in product design, testing, and production, staying in regular contact with relevant teams to move things forward
· Conduct root cause analysis and corrective action on quality issues, communicating findings clearly to those involved
· Ensure that products and manufacturing processes are meeting customer, industry, and governmental standards
· Create PPAP, APQP, and other quality documentation
· Plan and conduct quality / process audits
· Actively assist with training of quality and production associates as needed, explaining processes and answering questions on the floor
· Other duties as assigned

· Good time management skills and multitasking ability
· This position includes manufacturing and warehousing work environment. · Identify and resolve issues in product design, testing, and production
· Execute root cause analysis and drive corrective action on quality issues
· Ensure that products and manufacturing processes are meeting customer, industry, and governmental standards

· Plan and conduct quality / process audits
· Deliver training of quality and production associates as needed
· Other duties as assigned
